quote:
In the cold northern winds, a lone envoy can find friendship only by listening to the silence before speaking.  

The sharpest blade of justice must be forged in the quiet courage of those who would protect, not conquer.  

When a river floods the heart, its source remembers that even the smallest droplet can shape the world.  

Like a lantern swallowed by darkness, one misstep can scatter light into endless shadows.  

A silent mountain keeps its secrets only until someone chooses to smile at the summit.  

True strength is measured not by the roar of clashing swords, but by the quiet steadiness of one's breath.  

The weight of a single stone dropped into a vast ocean reminds us that even the smallest action may ripple across time.
